あらすじ

A beautiful stranger appears at your doorstep. Will you let her in? Dive into an erotic nightmare and decide the fates of those around you in this mystic thriller visual novel.

It all begins as a beautiful stranger appears at a lonesome doorstep. This is a love story of a man who slept too little and a stray cat.
